state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The authors describe debate as two GPT-4o debaters arguing opposite positions (true vs false) in strict turns (debater A, debater B, judge) for three rounds, with the judge able to question either debater, highlight issues or ask for clarification; consultancy is a single GPT-4o consultant arguing an assigned position over three structured rounds with judge questions. For COVID-19 the consultant's position is random (50% correct); for climate change consultants choose their preferred position to make a harder baseline.
title: Interactive debate vs single-sided consultancy with a questioning judge
